verdict.rationale: mise documents installing prebuilt artifacts directly from GitHub releases, aqua, and per-platform HTTP tarballs, so tools can be installed without building them. The official mise-action caches installed tools in CI by default. However, nothing documents a binary cache that replaces source compilation for languages that otherwise build locally, and the evidence never frames these installs as an alternative to compiling. Missing for 10: an explicit prebuilt-binary cache or precompiled-package mechanism that substitutes for source builds, a local or shared binary cache outside CI, and independent hands-on corroboration of speedups.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install prebuilt binary packages from a cache instead of compiling from source
